the question: Can a machine learn to learn algorithms?

The main takeaway from our work is that

a simple, general mechanism for module selection, combined with a general input tape encoding and layout, can lead to a modular algorithm induction architecture that generalizes well across a variety of tasks.
we show that it is possible to learn algorithms using a single general domain-agnostic architecture that is able to compose modules together in a flexible manner.
